messages:
claire: Draft announce post + benchmark narrative uploaded. Need quick eng/docs/sales sanity check: changelog blurb, canonical docs link, canary windows, and UTMs. Can we confirm in-thread? :mag:
tony: Paste the exact changelog text you plan to publish and the tentative canary schedule. Also say if we need a short Dedicated customer callout.
claire: Changelog TL;DR we want at top: "Staged canary rollout with automatic lightweight-fallback to preserve latency during burst loads; see docs for full rollout policy and metrics." Draft docs (staging): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/apr26-announce-draft
meera: Webinar slot we're targeting: Thu 04/14 16:00 PT. Slides + demo plan in the doc. Registration form needs UTMs + SFDC mapping. Proposed UTMs: utm_campaign=apr26_release&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email (paid ads add utm_term=paid).
zach: Eng canary suggestion (fine to paste):
```
- canary policy: apr26-release-canary
- schedule: 10% start -> hold 6h -> 40% -> 100% over 48h if green
- rollback target: stable-v3
- auto-fallback: quant-lite when token-error rate > 1.5%
```
zach: Dedicated note: keep short — "Dedicated customers have pinned capacity by default; Hosted customers get automated fallbacks unless opted out."
meera: SFDC mapping: queue=inbound_ml_products; tag product=Apr26Release; set lead_priority=high when utm_term=paid. Sales-ops confirm?
sales-ops: Confirmed. We'll map form webhook to that queue and add lead_priority when utm_term=paid. Need final UTMs before we publish the registration page.
claire: Marketing needs final go/no-go by EOD so we can set embargo lift for Fri morning. React with :thumbsup: when green or call out blockers.
tony: :thumbsup: Changelog wording ok, canary schedule fine. I'll sync with SRE on exact monitoring windows.
meera: :thumbsup: I'll publish docs at 18:00 PT and paste canonical /docs link here.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: name=apr26-release-canary, variant=quant-lite, initial_traffic=10%, monitor_url=/ops/releases/apr26
claire: Thanks everyone — I'll update the announce draft with the staging changelog and post final links once Meera publishes. :rocket:
